name: What types of bathroom faucets are available for installation?

mainEntity.name: What types of bathroom faucets are available for installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are several common types of bathroom faucets, each with different installation considerations. Single-hole faucets combine the spout and handles into one unit. Centerset faucets have handles and spout mounted on a single base plate. Widespread faucets feature separate components for the hot and cold handles and the spout. Wall-mounted faucets require plumbing within the wall, offering a clean counter look. Bridge faucets connect the hot and cold water supplies through a visible bridge. Understanding these types helps determine compatibility with your existing sink or if a new sink is needed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common types include single-hole, centerset, widespread, wall-mounted, and bridge faucets. Each type has specific installation requirements.
